title: The temple that volunteers built
dek: Before it was one of the largest Hindu temples in the country, the Sri Siva Vishnu Temple was an idea among a few friends. It still runs on volunteers, organized into committees.
name: Sri Siva Vishnu Temple
role: Board of Trustees and volunteer committees
imageAlt: The white gopurams of the Sri Siva Vishnu Temple in Lanham, Maryland
quote: The symbol of a community's joint aspirations and efforts.
